plugins.name: marcora
plugins.description: The context layer for GTM teams. Bundles the hosted Marcora MCP server (OAuth or API token) with its two companion skills — marcora-mcp (object model + the five core workflows) and marcora-workflow-builder (build, modify, run reusable multi-step workflows) — so your AI assistant can create on-brand marketing content, manage brand context and blueprints, and automate recurring marketing work.
